title: RASSIE’S ‘FAKE BOK CHIC’ - Coach in AI fake vid, making gat of the iconic ‘White Chicks’ movie
key_facts: An AI-generated video shows Springboks coach Rassie Erasmus singing to the Webb Ellis Cup.
It parodies the 'White Chicks' scene where Terry Crews sings along to Vanessa Carlton's 'A Thousand Miles'.
The Daily Voice says the video was posted by an online user, name not given in the text.
The Springboks lost 42-38 to Australia in Perth after Erasmus made 13 changes.
They had earlier won a 3-1 Test series against the All Blacks.
quote_evidence: a new video circulating online of Springboks coach Rassie Erasmus serenading the Webb Ellis Cup
The Bokke head coach has frequently embraced his playful side on social media
why_it_matters_hint: A harmless AI parody of a sports figure spreading online, openly labelled as fake.
notes: Video poster not named in the text. Rugby context from the article.
